initial_contains: all public train and validation nodes, remainder sampled without labels
warmup: CPU sparse adjacency; existing GCN hidden=16; 200 epochs; validation-selected; fixed thereafter
trust: train labels known; other labels predicted once at initial state or arrival; confidence >=0.8; no later refresh
checks: all active radii and all structural edge weights after every insertion; no test labels passed to operator; paired deterministic operator outputs at final state
scope: structural equivalence under fixed trust assignments; no new accuracy or latency claim
retention: keep every seed, including zero trusted arrivals
